Gomez currently has over 284 million followers on the platform.]] [[File:Virat Kohli June 2016 (cropped).jpg|thumb|upright|[[Virat Kohli]] is the most-followed Asian on Instagram, with over 176 million followers.]] [[File:Nicki Minaj VMA 2018 03 (cropped).png|upright|thumb|[[Nicki Minaj]] is the most-followed rapper on Instagram, with over 166 million followers.]] This article is a list which contains the top 50 accounts with most followers on the photo and video-sharing social platform [[Instagram]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.trackalytics.com/the-most-followed-instagram-profiles/page/1/|title=The Most Followed Instagram Profiles|website=Trackalytics.com|access-date=April 9, 2020}}{{Cite web|title=Top 50 Most Followed Instagram Business / Creator Accounts (Sorted by Followers Count)|url=https://socialblade.com/instagram/top/50/followers|access-date=January 2, 2021|website=[[Social Blade]]}}{{Cite web|title=Top 50 Most Followed Instagram accounts in 2021 {{!}} TikTokBlade|url=https://insiflow.com/instagram/top|url-status=live|access-date=2021-06-09|website=Social Media Marketing & Management Dashboard|language=en}} {{As of|2021|12|lc=y}}, the most-followed individual is Portuguese footballer [[Cristiano Ronaldo]] with over 384 million followers, and the most-followed woman is American reality television star [[Kylie Jenner]] with over 295 million followers. Instagram has its own brand account on the platform, and with over 455 million followers, it is the most-followed account overall. ''[[National Geographic]]'' is the second most-followed brand account, with over 199 million followers.
